description: Texas Instruments Incorporated designs and manufactures semiconductors that it sells to electronics designers and manufacturers all over the world, and its operations began in 1930 and it is incorporated in Delaware, with headquarters in Dallas, Texas and design, manufacturing or sales operations in more than 30 countries. Its two reportable segments are Analog and Embedded Processing, and it reports the results of its remaining business activities in Other, generating $17.68 billion of revenue in 2025, with sales of Embedded Processing products generating about 15 percent of revenue in 2025, and that segment includes microcontrollers, processors, wireless connectivity and radar products. For decades it has operated with a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors, and it was a pioneer in the transition from vacuum tubes to transistors and then to integrated circuits.
